text:
jordan: Heads up — I'm proposing we add a lightweight sampling header on the SDK gateway so console can ingest representative telemetry without blowing storage. quick take?

maria: Noted. What header name + semantics? :thinking:

jordan: thinking `X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 0.05` (float 0-1) — gateway sets it per-request based on routing policy, sdks pass through if present. Example:
```
X-RW-Telemetry-Sample: 0.05
X-RW-Route: user-optimized
```

sam: Dangerous if sdks mutate it. Py/TS/Go need a consistent passthrough behavior. Any chance we can make it immutable in the gateway? :eyes:

rachael: Also need console mapping — sample must correlate to cost attribution + quota dashboards. If sample rate changes mid-rollout dashboards will look weird.

maria: Yes — console should receive sample + policy-id. Maybe `X-RW-Policy` header too. Otherwise we lose which rule produced the sample.

jordan: Agreed. Proposal: gateway emits both headers, sdks are allowed to forward but not rewrite. We'll ship SDKs that default to passthrough and add a validation in the client libs to ignore corrupt values.

sam: For backward compat: older SDKs won't know `X-RW-Policy`, so gateway should accept that and still work. We need a fallback path for attribution — maybe a deterministic hash when header missing.

rachael: Rollout UX: start canary with `0.01` sample, bake dashboards in console using a derived scaling factor. Add an explicit flag in console to enable sampled telemetry view.

maria: Concern: sampling will undercount rare errors. We should also send full traces for errors (sampling override on 5xx). Make sample header semantics support overrides.

jordan: Good point — add `X-RW-Telemetry-Force: 1` when request triggered an error downstream; gateway will sample fully on those.

sam: Implementation detail for SDKs: Py/TS/Go will implement a passthrough header middleware. I'll open PRs with tests that assert headers are preserved and not canonicalized (case-preserving?).

rachael: Quick checklist:
- gateway: emit sample + policy headers
- sdks: passthrough middleware, validation
- console: sampled telemetry scaling + UI toggle
- quota: ensure sampled data maps back to true usage for billing
- rollout: canary 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100%

maria: +1. Who wants tasks? :raised_hands:

sam: I'll own SDK patches (py/ts/go).

rachael: Console dashboard work — will prototype a "sampled telemetry" tile.

jordan: I'll update gateway PR and the rollout playbook.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: gateway/sampling-proto -> canary (sha: abc123) :rocket:

maria: If canary looks good, let's coordinate a phone at 2pm. otherwise we'll rollback. :thumbsup:

sam: noted — will add e2e that simulates header missing + 5xx override.

rachael: Also add a one-off script to backfill last 24h metrics if we need to compare pre/post rollout.

jordan: thanks team — I'll post the RFC doc and PR links in this thread shortly. :white_check_mark:
